objective: Fix the defect e6 found (ho-mv3uq93d-0114f12e): after the purchase is confirmed the request page still showed 'You are back from PayPal… Waiting for PayPal to confirm'.
context: The return notice (?paypal=returned&order=<id>) now follows the current state, per the coordinator's corrected brief: while the returned order's payment is approved, authorization_pending or unknown it reads 'You are back from PayPal for <supplier>. Waiting for PayPal to confirm; this page updates by itself.'; once the payment is authorized, capture_pending or captured it reads 'PayPal approval for <supplier> is confirmed.' (tone ok, no 'waiting'; with the fake provider the return handler authorizes at once, so this is the usual first look and e6's journey keeps its data-testid paypal-returned); once the current plan is executed or non_executable the notice is not shown at all. An unknown order or a payment that did not go through shows nothing rather than a claim. The 'cancelled' notice is also dropped once the plan is executed or non_executable or the order is no longer 'created'. My first attempt hid the notice once authorized; that broke test/browser/journey-happy.test.js (waits for paypal-returned) and was superseded before completion, and its evidence runs (ev-mv3urzew-016f4c86 red, ev-mv3usa2z-013c026d, ev-mv3uupm7-01f221e7, and the failed browser run ev-mv3uwete-0154f72a) are not cited as proof. Only public/js/views/request-detail.js and two frontend unit test files changed; src/app.js and e4's files were not touched, and e6's journey test was not edited.
inputs: coordinator correction to the brief (three notice states)
expectedOutput: Green verification command, npm test and npm run test:browser including journey-happy at 360 and 1280 px.
acceptanceCriteria: After a PayPal return the paypal-returned notice waits only while the payment is approved or authorization_pending
Once authorized or captured it says the approval is confirmed, with no waiting wording
Once the plan is executed or non_executable the return notice is not shown
Failing-first case recorded red against the original code, then green
completedWork: returnNoticeModel in public/js/views/request-detail.js implements the three states. The new case in test/unit/frontend/payments.test.js (view-model and rendered page; waiting for approved/authorization_pending/unknown, confirmed for authorized/capture_pending/captured, absent for executed and non_executable plans with any order status, absent for an unknown order; plus the cancelled-notice case) was recorded red against the original code first (ev:ev-mv3v6fdd-0132eec1, 2 failing, 23 passing), then the fix made it green. test/unit/frontend/dashboards.test.js's old return-notice case used an order still in 'created', where 'waiting' is untrue; it now sets authorization_pending first. Verification command: 166 tests, 166 pass. npm test: 2087 tests, 2079 pass, 0 fail, 8 skipped. npm run test:browser: 10 of 10 pass, including RS-31(a) happy journey at 360x800 and 1280x800 (seen as ok 1 and ok 2 in the evidence log).
remainingIssues: The red run ev:ev-mv3v6fdd-0132eec1 is a deliberate FAILED record (the new cases against the original returnNoticeModel); it is the failing-first proof, not a defect.
Contract assumption 3 of the first handoff still stands: Order.payment.status exposes approved, authorization_pending, authorized and captured in RequestView.orders.
nextAction: delivery-lead: re-run e6's review of the happy journey screenshot (test/browser/out/journey-happy-360.png) if desired; no further frontend work is known.

lessonDecisions.note: This claim edits one browser view-model and its unit tests; it designs no hook or guard mapping writes to a project root, so the nested-record root rule has nothing to apply to.
